title: The GTA 4 hero Trevor Philips killed in GTA 5
subject: trevor
description:
Did you recognize Johnny the first time you played? 👇

Trevor Philips' brutal introduction, and the one sentence on the news that told him Michael was alive. Spoilers for Grand Theft Auto V.

scenes.text: Trevor Philips' first scene ends a GTA 4 hero's story.
The man is Johnny Klebitz, leader of The Lost biker club in The Lost and Damned.
In the mission Mr. Philips, Johnny finds his ex, Ashley, with Trevor outside a trailer in Sandy Shores.
Trevor kills him before the player even takes control, then goes after the rest of The Lost.
Around the same time, the news covered a robbery at the Vangelico jewelry store and repeated what one robber said.
"You forget a thousand things every day, pal." Trevor knew that line. Michael Townley was alive.
